name: ecommerce-microservices-root
description: Root workspace for e-commerce microservices application

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix gateway && npm install --prefix services/user-service && npm install --prefix services/product-service && npm install --prefix services/order-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix gateway" "npm run dev --prefix services/user-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/product-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/order-service" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: concurrently "npm run test --prefix gateway" "npm run test --prefix services/user-service" "npm run test --prefix services/product-service" "npm run test --prefix services/order-service" "npm run test --prefix frontend"
